Very good! Are you ready? The time has come to launch the new simple story: "2069: Delta", a very special story for me, since it is based on two very popular dystopian novels... Are you able to guess what these novels are and capture their references for those who have read it? The story focuses mainly on a mysterious fictional country in the middle of the Pacific, our pair of girls go to investigate undercover as vacationers and will soon realize how strange that country is. I hope you like it.
